name: SCU-14
description: "Control amplifier of all-silicon transistor configuration.A head amplifier is mounted for MC type cartridge.Because it amplifies very low-level inputs, the emphasis is on the choice of transistors to be used and the amount of noise is greatly reduced.The head amp uses the Phono L terminal, and the Phono H terminal is connected to a 2 to 10 mV output cartridge.The playback head output of a tape recorder can be amplified directly. This terminal can be switched between High (19cm/s) and Low (9.5cm/s).The volume uses a specially selected variable resistor for communication equipment to minimize the interlocking deviation.This volume can also control the input from the tape monitor out jack, and the output from the center channel jack.Equipped with a switchable balance control, each channel is capable of -1.5 dB and -3dB attenuation.Switch type tone control is adopted.This tone control changes the characteristics of the low frequency range below 200 Hz and the high frequency range above 3 kHz, but does not change the middle frequency range between 200 Hz and 300 kHz.Mode switch is mounted.Equipped with a muting switch that can reduce the volume by 15 db with one touch operation.It is equipped with a tape monitor switch. When it is set to the IN position, the source at the position of the Input switch is played as it is. At the same time, recording can be made from the tape monitor in jack on the back.With a center channel output terminal, 3D playback is possible.The center channel outputs a mixed signal of the left and right channel signals. This terminal has a single stage emitter follower to eliminate the influence between the two channels. The gain of the center channel is higher than that of both channels by the amount of mixing loss.Each unit was adjusted very precisely in order to emphasize sound quality, and the production quantity was limited.The Phono L terminal uses a German DIN 5-pin plug and comes with a 1.5m 4-core shielded wire with a 5-pin plug that is custom-made for connection to the pickup.To connect the shield wire to the arm, wire R + for red, R - for green, L + for white, and L - for black, and connect the ground wire. If the ground wire of the arm itself is connected to the negative side of either the left or right channel at the terminal of the lead wire of the arm like the arm of SME, talk this separately and connect it.Equipped with two power switch-linked service outlets.A power switch that can withstand a current of 5A is used, and care must be taken that the total power consumption of the equipment connected to the service outlet and the SCU-14 does not exceed 500W.Uses a 1A fuse.Wood cabinet with walnut finish is included."
